verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents built-in AI features. The closest fit is AI-powered compliance support that answers questions, generates HR documents and monitors regulatory changes, which is a limited form of task delegation. AI-suggested modifications for missing punches are an embedded aid, not a general assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of a general in-product assistant that can carry out core payroll/HR actions (running payroll, updating employee records, approvals) on request, any documentation of how the assistant works or its scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
